trust_decision.summary: msPostGISLayerTranslateFilter decides how an item/value (MS_STRING) filter value is put into SQL; when the item is declared numeric (gml_<item>_type Integer/Long/Real) the escaped value is appended unquoted, so the value is trusted to be a number without being checked.

landing_point.why: The summary names PostGIS runtime query translation of numeric filter values; the only unquoted value append in msPostGISLayerTranslateFilter is the is_numeric else-branch.

fix_sites.entry_point: OGC API Features GET /{map}/ogcapi/collections/{id}/items/{featureId} (src/mapogcapi.cpp:1332-1342); also mapserv mode=itemquery/itemnquery/itemfeaturequery with qitem/qstring (src/mapservutil.c:1745-1752, src/mapservutil.c:1633-1640) and MapScript layerObj.queryByAttributes (src/mapscript/swiginc/layer.i:394-415)

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: src/mapmssql2008.c:3834-3859 and src/maporaclespatial.c:4225-4245: the MSSQL and Oracle drivers' LayerTranslateFilter build the same item/value predicate from filter->string with sprintf('%s') and no escaping at all (TODO comments at src/mapmssql2008.c:3854, src/maporaclespatial.c:4239-4240); not touched by the fix

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The advisory is titled PostGIS and about numeric-typed items; the MSSQL/Oracle drivers are other database backends with a different (quoted-string) code path, so a solver can argue they are separate drivers outside the report.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Numeric item values are deliberately left unquoted/uncast so database indexes are used (comment at 3711-3712); legitimate numeric ids such as negative, decimal or exponent forms must still match, and string feature ids on Character items via the same OGC API route must keep working. A fix in the OGC API handler that demands digits-only ids, or one that casts numeric columns to ::text, breaks these.

O6_input_shapes: plain item/value MS_STRING filter on a numeric-typed item (src/mappostgis.cpp:3720-3738)
case-insensitive item/value filter (MS_EXP_INSENSITIVE), which also appends the numeric value unquoted inside upper(...) (src/mappostgis.cpp:3716-3719, 3736-3742)
numeric type coming from explicit gml_<item>_type metadata or from gml_types=auto introspection (src/mappostgis.cpp:3179-3181)

O7_producer.where: src/mappostgis.cpp:3040-3092 (msPostGISPassThroughFieldDefinitions maps PostgreSQL column OIDs to gml_<item>_type Integer/Long/Real when gml_types=auto, stored via msUpdateGMLFieldMetadata at src/mapows.c:1317-1325); that metadata decides is_numeric in src/maplayer.c:323-335

O8_uncovered_routes.route: MSSQL2008 driver item/value filter translation appends the user value inside quotes with no escaping (same OGC API / itemquery entry points, MSSQL backend)
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Different database driver from the PostGIS one named in the advisory; quoted string path, not the numeric path

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Oracle Spatial driver item/value filter translation appends the user value inside quotes with no escaping
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Different database driver; code comment frames it as 'backwards compatibility' with SQL snippets (src/maporaclespatial.c:4222-4223)

O8b_injection_room.sibling: uid predicate in msPostGISBuildSQLWhere chooses an unquoted form when the uid item is numeric; a variant taking the id as a string instead of a long would mirror the flaw
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Same is_numeric/unquoted idiom already used here for index-friendly id lookup

O8b_injection_room.sibling: IN-list literal branch quotes every element; a numeric-item variant that skips quotes for index use (like 3732-3738) is a plausible maintainer optimisation
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Same index-preservation motive as the published flaw, in the adjacent token branch

O8b_injection_room.sibling: OGR SQL translation already special-cases numeric items via msLayerPropertyIsNumeric for bindings; an item/value literal path there with the same shortcut would be a realistic second implementation
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: OGR translator shares the numeric-type helper and the 'avoid cast to keep indexes' rationale

O9_family: SQL injection (CWE-89) via unquoted numeric literal in native filter translation

O10_build.toolchain: CMake, C++17 compiler, GDAL, PROJ, libpq (USE_POSTGIS); optional MSSQL/Oracle client libs for the O8 drivers
O10_build.project_tests: msautotest (msautotest/api for OGC API, msautotest/query/filters_postgis.map, msautotest/wxs/*postgis*.map, msautotest/mspython/test_postgis.py); needs a local PostGIS database

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Validate featureId as digits in the OGC API items handler (src/mapogcapi.cpp:1320-1340), leaving mapserv qitem/qstring, MapScript queryByAttributes and the MSSQL/Oracle drivers open and breaking string ids.

out_of_scope_notes: src/mapquery.cpp:766-778 filterTranslateToLogical concatenates the MS_STRING value into a MapServer expression without escaping when merging with a layer FILTER (expression-grammar injection, not this advisory).
The O8 MSSQL/Oracle unescaped item/value paths look like a broader unpatched weakness than this advisory; worth a separate maintainer report rather than benchmark use only.
src/mappostgis.cpp:3731 msPostGISEscapeSQLParam can return NULL on escape error, after which the fixed code calls strlen on it (robustness, not pursued).
unverified: Whether MSSQL/Oracle routes are present in the latest release: no latest tree provided.
Exact runtime order of GetItems (auto types) versus TranslateFilter in msQueryByFilter not traced to the call; inferred from msLayerWhichItems at src/mapquery.cpp:959.
strtod-based fix accepts empty string, leading whitespace, 'nan'/'inf' and hex floats; whether any of these yields SQL beyond a syntax error was not analysed.
Whether qstring validation (src/mapservutil.c:1727-1739) blocks the mapserv route depends on operator-configured regex; msEvalRegex behaviour with a NULL pattern not checked.
